text:
mira: Heads-up — proposing a regional SLI aggregation + small dashboard for latency-by-region, cross-region failover impact, and traffic-split metrics. Need infra + console input. Sketch: (design.google.com/proto)

tarun: For rollups we should capture p50/p95/p99 + request counts and failover_count per region. Also want traffic-split ratio per-route.

jess: Runtime today emits labels: region, zone, backend_pool, routing_policy. It does NOT emit failover_origin or split_weight currently. We can add them but watch cardinality.

sam: Agreed on cardinality. Runtime can emit a boolean 'was_failover' + a hashed 'route_hash' for mapping. For split ratios, recommend computing an aggregated gauge at ingestion rather than per-request label.

kevin: Console needs: compare two regions side-by-side, route selector, time-shift compare, and a heatmap for tail latency during failover windows. Also annotation support for rollouts/traffic-shifts.

mira: Proposed aggregation schema (1m rollups). Example:

```yaml
metrics:
  - name: redwood.latency.ms
    labels: [region, route_hash]
    aggregations: [p50, p95, p99, count]
  - name: redwood.failover.count
    labels: [region, to_region, route_hash]
  - name: redwood.traffic.split
    type: gauge
    labels: [region, route_hash]
rollup:
  window: 60s
  retention: 90d
notes: "route_hash should be 64-bit hex to avoid cardinality explosion"
```

tarun: route_hash + region keeps series manageable, but we need a service to resolve route_hash -> route_id/route_name for UI. Prefer a small mapping service rather than exposing full route ids in TSDB.

jess: Storage note — for real-time dashboards use pre-aggregated 1m series in Cortex/Prometheus remote-write, long-term queries in ClickHouse. We'll need a budget estimate for extra series from failover and split gauges.

sam: Implementation plan: exporter v2 to add hashed labels + was_failover flag; 1% full metadata sampling into traces for debugging. Aggregator job to compute per-region rollups and write to metrics-store. I'll open infra PR with rollout plan (canary by region).

devops-bot: deploy-bot: metric-exporter v2.3.1 rolled out to us-west1/us-east1/eu-west1 — deploy succeeded :white_check_mark:

mira: Summary / action items: 
- sam: infra PR for exporter + aggregator job (canary plan)
- jess: storage budget & retention proposal
- kevin: console mockups for region compare + heatmap (include annotation UX)
- tarun: route_hash mapping API spec
Meeting: Thu 10:00 for sync. Thanks all :thumbsup:
